added.title: Sr Manager, Software Development & Engineering Lead (PL)
added.description:
Your opportunity

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

Schwab is looking for a Senior Manager, Software Development & Engineering (PL) to lead multiple Agile and Lean engineering teams supporting large-scale, business-critical technology platforms. In this role, you will translate business priorities into clear engineering objectives, guide delivery execution, improve platform reliability, and strengthen operational excellence across teams.

You will partner closely with product, architecture, SRE, QA, program management, finance, talent acquisition, business stakeholders, and adjacent engineering groups to deliver cohesive outcomes. This role is ideal for a people leader and technical leader who can operate across strategy and execution, build trusted partnerships, develop engineering talent, and lead teams through platform modernization and responsible GenAI adoption.

Your leadership will help teams improve quality, reduce operational toil, modernize legacy platforms, and deliver reliable technology outcomes that support Schwab’s clients, business partners, and long-term technology strategy.

What you have

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated Engineering Management experience leading multiple software engineering teams responsible for platform delivery, modernization, operational support, and production ownership
Ability to provide Technical Leadership by guiding technical direction, influencing architecture decisions, improving engineering standards, and helping teams navigate complex tradeoffs
Strong Systems Engineering capability, including understanding scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable platforms across applications, services, dependencies, and data flows
Experience leading disciplined Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices across planning, delivery, testing, validation, documentation, deployment, and operational readiness
Ability to use Generative AI or AI-assisted engineering practices responsibly to improve planning, delivery, quality, documentation, automation, modernization, and operational efficiency
Strong Stakeholder Management skills, including the ability to align product, architecture, SRE, QA, program management, finance, business partners, and engineering teams around shared outcomes
Demonstrated ability to develop managers, technical leads, and engineers through coaching, mentorship, feedback, career development, and talent planning
Strong technical judgment, business acumen, communication skills, and ability to make data-informed decisions in complex or ambiguous environments

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with large-scale software systems using modern engineering technologies such as Java, .NET, cloud platforms, containers, microservices, relational databases, NoSQL, and messaging platforms
Experience leading teams in a large, complex organization, including onshore and offshore delivery models
Experience improving operational health through KPIs, SLAs, production readiness, monitoring, documentation, and continuous improvement
Experience leading platform modernization, including legacy system analysis, modernization assessment, migration planning, validation, deployment, and adoption of modern engineering practices
Familiarity with tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted engineering tools
Experience building mechanisms that scale adoption and knowledge sharing, such as champion forums, reusable practices, playbooks, or team learning communities

Learning Opportunities

In this role, you will continue strengthening your leadership across enterprise-scale platform delivery, modernization strategy, operational excellence, and responsible GenAI adoption. You will have the opportunity to deepen your experience leading multiple engineering teams, improving platform health, and shaping engineering practices that influence how technology teams deliver at scale.

You will also expand your ability to apply GenAI across the full SDLC, including planning, quality, documentation, automation, operational toil reduction, and modernization. Through cross-functional partnerships, you will gain broader exposure to business-critical technology platforms, enterprise architecture direction, SRE practices, QA strategy, and business stakeholder alignment.

Skill Development Values

At Schwab, skills are developed through meaningful work, mentorship, training, collaboration, and continuous learning. This role offers the opportunity to grow as a leader who develops others, builds trust across teams, and helps engineers apply technology in ways that create measurable business impact.

"In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities."

What’s in it for you

At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
Paid parental leave and family building benefits
Tuition reimbursement
Health, dental, and vision insurance

added.title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering
added.description:
Job Description:

Role Overview

At Cboe, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world. 

The goal of the Cboe Platform Engineering group focuses around building a scalable and secure foundations platform, enabling the Cboe operations, software engineering and application teams to deploy, validate, and operate their services in production, improve resiliency of the service and increase organizational efficiency by reducing operational toil and increase system efficiency through architectural evolution. 

The Senior Manager of Platform Engineering will play a pivotal role in driving the design, implementation, and management of our cloud-native infrastructure across both public cloud (AWS) and on-premises Linux environments. Reporting to the Sr. Director, Platform Engineering, this role will lead a team of platform engineers responsible for building scalable, secure, and resilient platforms — running workloads across hybrid infrastructure focused on outcomes.  

Your responsibilities will be: 

Lead and manage a team of platform engineers responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud-native infrastructure across AWS and on-prem Linux/Kubernetes environments. 
Lead the architectural design of platform solutions across hybrid (cloud and on-prem) environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security best practices are incorporated. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, architect solutions, and ensure successful delivery of platform projects. 
Drive the adoption of infrastructure as code (IaC) principles and practices, leveraging tools such as Terraform and Pulumi to automate and standardize deployments across cloud and on-prem. 
Establish and maintain robust monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure the reliability and performance of the platform across cloud and on-prem. 
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development. 
Champion a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability within the Platform Engineering Team and across the organization. 

The ideal candidate has 

8+ years of experience with major Cloud vendors including AWS, Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure, with strong expertise in AWS. 
Hands-on experience operating cloud-native workloads on Kubernetes in both cloud and on-premises Linux environments. 
Proven experience leading and managing high-performing engineering teams in a fast-paced environment with a record of project delivery and architecture of production systems. 
In-depth knowledge of cloud-native and platform architecture principles, best practices, and design patterns. 
Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, and Jenkins. 
Proficiency in container orchestration technologies, especially Kubernetes. 
Strong understanding of Linux systems administration, networking, security, and compliance requirements across hybrid environments. 
Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization. 
Thorough understanding of the financial markets a plus. 
AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, and/or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD), or equivalent, are highly desirable. 

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $170,000-$220,000 in Kansas, $187,000-$242,000 in Chicago, and $212,500-$275,000 in New York, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

Any communication from Cboe regarding this position will only come from a Cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together. Join a technology team focused on building the next generation of platforms powering Schwab’s Workplace Services business. In this role, you’ll design and deliver scalable, enterprise-grade applications that support millions of retirement plan participants while helping modernize critical systems, user experiences, and integration capabilities. Demonstrated expertise in Enterprise Architecture/System Design to design scalable services, architecture patterns, and modern platforms that support high-volume enterprise applications and business growth.

added.title: Director of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Transformation Technology
added.description:
Your opportunity

Director of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Transformation Technology

The Corporate Systems organization within Charles Schwab’s Technology organization is comprised of several teams that support the goals of Schwab’s internal corporate functions and employees through the delivery and maintenance of innovative technology solutions. The Corporate Systems organization will be working closely with Finance and HR business executives to evaluate, select, plan for, and deliver a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system to consolidate and integrate various business processes across these functions. The Director of ERP Transformation Technology will lead all technology aspects of the multi-year ERP program, which will be one of Schwab’s largest transformational programs.

The Director of ERP Transformation Technology will partner closely with technology leadership and the business executives to transform the relevant business processes and deliver this critical business and technology solution. In doing so, the Director of ERP Transformation Technology will form and lead a team of high-performing technology resources to deliver and provide ongoing support of the ERP application.

This role requires an experienced enterprise technology leader who has built and led the strategy and delivery of large-scale, end-to-end ERP transformations within a comparably sized financial institution or another highly regulated enterprise. The leader will build and manage a team of full-time employees and provide long-term leadership continuity for this critical capability.

What You’ll Do

Define and execute the ERP technology strategy, target-state architecture, operating model, and multi-year roadmap that supports Schwab's Finance and Human Resources transformation objectives
Lead a multi-year enterprise transformation of Finance and HR capabilities through implementation of a new ERP platform, modern data foundation, AI-enabled capabilities, and future-state operating model
Attract, develop, and retain world-class technology talent while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning
Lead software vendor evaluation, selection, contract negotiations, implementation partner governance, and ongoing strategic vendor relationships.
Partner with Finance and HR executives to transform and modernize core business processes, data, controls, and operating models enabled through ERP capabilities and leading practices.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define and deliver the scope, approach, timelines, resource requirements, and major milestones to deliver the ERP program.
Partner with business stakeholders to drive organizational change management, business readiness, user adoption, and realization of transformation benefits throughout the ERP lifecycle.
Accountable for ERP architecture, integration strategy, data migration, master data management, security controls, reporting architecture, and alignment with Schwab technology standards.
Accountable for delivering all technology initiatives and deliverables of the ERP program in an effective and timely manner. Ensure all initiatives are appropriately resourced. Track and measure progress against initiatives, communicate status, and effectively manage all issues and risks. Quickly intervene to resolve any issues that arise.
Act as a technology thought leader and partner. Influence business and technology stakeholders to drive appropriate outcomes and approaches
Manage relationships with senior business partners and technology partners, ensuring a positive and collaborative work environment with shared accountability and responsibility.
Drive success and engagement of the program team members by ensuring well-defined roles and responsibilities, communicating the vision and the roadmap, and ensuring team members understand the impact of their work and deliverables
Partner with business stakeholders to drive organizational change management, business readiness, user adoption, and realization of transformation benefits throughout the ERP lifecycle
Establish and track measurable business outcomes including operational efficiency, process effectiveness, risk reduction, data quality improvements, and financial benefits realization
Lead application rationalization and modernization efforts to reduce technical debt and simplify the Finance and HR technology landscape
Define and implement the long-term support and operational model for the ERP platform, including production support, enhancements, release management, and continuous improvement.
Continually look for opportunities to drive process improvements in delivering the ERP program while ensuring effective delivery of all milestones and deliverables
Ensure the team complies with all Schwab and regulatory standards and policies.
Ensure operational excellence by closely managing program budget, risks and issues, and other operational items. Be aggressive against resolving outstanding issues.
Own the end-to-end strategy and execution of a large-scale ERP transformation, from platform evaluation and roadmap development through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing optimization.
Build, lead, and develop a team of full-time technology professionals, establishing the leadership structure, capabilities, and succession depth required to sustain the ERP organization over the long term.
Define and lead the integration of AI, automation, and advanced analytics across the ERP ecosystem, including strategy, architecture, governance, controls, and operating model required to deliver scalable business value in a highly regulated environment.

What you have

Technical/Functional Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related technical field
10+ years of Technology experience in application development, project delivery, offshore and vendor management, and people management. At least 8 years of experience in leading large, high performing application development and delivery teams at the Director (or equivalent) level.
Proven experience leading enterprise-wide ERP transformation programs involving Finance, HR, Data, Security, Architecture, Integration, Change Management, and Operating Model transformation, ideally at one or more major Financial Services companies
Experience with leading ERP platforms such as Oracle Fusion Cloud, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent enterprise SaaS platforms
Demonstrated experience evaluating and leveraging AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies to enhance ERP capabilities, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision making
Experience managing multi-year technology budgets exceeding $50M and large-scale vendor and consulting engagements.
Expertise in business transformation enabled by technology, finance and HR transformation, and process improvement and standardization
Deep experience with implementing and managing third-party vendor applications and in managing complex third-party vendor relationships.
Transformational leader who operates with a high sense of urgency and agility to support this dynamic area and the transformation required to support Schwab’s ERP strategy
Demonstrated ability to build strategic relationships and collaborate/communicate effectively across all levels of business partners and across all groups within the Technology organization. Ability to navigate effectively and influence within all levels of the organization.
Proven track record of successfully leading and managing technology professionals in multiple locations and building high performing organizations. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage an engaged and highly productive workforce.
Demonstrated ability to influence executive leadership, drive organizational alignment, and successfully navigate complex enterprise decisions involving competing priorities.
Excellent communication skills. Strong presence and poise under pressure in senior executive meetings.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Self-motivated, results-oriented and flexible with impeccable follow-up, strong delivery focus, positive attitude and collaborative style.
Proven accountability for building the strategy and leading delivery of full, large-scale ERP transformation programs at an organization comparable in size and complexity to Schwab, preferably within financial services or another highly regulated industry.
Hands-on executive leadership experience with one or more major ERP ecosystems, including Workday, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft, with responsibility extending beyond a single module, workstream, or implementation phase.
Demonstrated experience building and directly leading a sizable ERP technology organization, including workforce planning, leadership development, performance management, and succession planning.
Deep understanding of AI and its integration with enterprise ERP platforms, including demonstrated experience translating AI capabilities into an executable roadmap across Finance, HR, data, workflows, controls, and employee experiences.
Proven leadership of large, multidisciplinary teams responsible for ERP, AI, data, architecture, integration, security, and program delivery, with the executive presence to align senior business and technology stakeholders.
Financial Services industry (in a highly regulated environment) and finance/accounting experience is strongly preferred.

What’s in it for you

At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
Paid parental leave and family building benefits
Tuition reimbursement
Health, dental, and vision insurance

Define and implement the long-term support and operational model for the ERP platform, including production support, enhancements, release management, and continuous improvement.
Continually look for opportunities to drive process improvements in delivering the ERP program while ensuring effective delivery of all milestones and deliverables
Ensure the team complies with all Schwab and regulatory standards and policies.
Ensure operational excellence by closely managing program budget, risks and issues, and other operational items. Be aggressive against resolving outstanding issues.
Own the end-to-end strategy and execution of a large-scale ERP transformation, from platform evaluation and roadmap development through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing optimization.
Build, lead, and develop a team of full-time technology professionals, establishing the leadership structure, capabilities, and succession depth required to sustain the ERP organization over the long term.
Define and lead the integration of AI, automation, and advanced analytics across the ERP ecosystem, including strategy, architecture, governance, controls, and operating model required to deliver scalable business value in a highly regulated environment.

What you have

Technical/Functional Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related technical field
10+ years of Technology experience in application development, project delivery, offshore and vendor management, and people management. At least 8 years of experience in leading large, high performing application development and delivery teams at the Director (or equivalent) level.
Proven experience leading enterprise-wide ERP transformation programs involving Finance, HR, Data, Security, Architecture, Integration, Change Management, and Operating Model transformation, ideally at one or more major Financial Services companies
Experience with leading ERP platforms such as Oracle Fusion Cloud, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent enterprise SaaS platforms
Demonstrated experience evaluating and leveraging AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies to enhance ERP capabilities, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision making
Experience managing multi-year technology budgets exceeding $50M and large-scale vendor and consulting engagements.
Expertise in business transformation enabled by technology, finance and HR transformation, and process improvement and standardization
Deep experience with implementing and managing third-party vendor applications and in managing complex third-party vendor relationships.
Transformational leader who operates with a high sense of urgency and agility to support this dynamic area and the transformation required to support Schwab’s ERP strategy
Demonstrated ability to build strategic relationships and collaborate/communicate effectively across all levels of business partners and across all groups within the Technology organization. Ability to navigate effectively and influence within all levels of the organization.
Proven track record of successfully leading and managing technology professionals in multiple locations and building high performing organizations. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage an engaged and highly productive workforce.
Demonstrated ability to influence executive leadership, drive organizational alignment, and successfully navigate complex enterprise decisions involving competing priorities.
Excellent communication skills. Strong presence and poise under pressure in senior executive meetings.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Self-motivated, results-oriented and flexible with impeccable follow-up, strong delivery focus, positive attitude and collaborative style.
Proven accountability for building the strategy and leading delivery of full, large-scale ERP transformation programs at an organization comparable in size and complexity to Schwab, preferably within financial services or another highly regulated industry.
Hands-on executive leadership experience with one or more major ERP ecosystems, including Workday, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft, with responsibility extending beyond a single module, workstream, or implementation phase.
Demonstrated experience building and directly leading a sizable ERP technology organization, including workforce planning, leadership development, performance management, and succession planning.
Deep understanding of AI and its integration with enterprise ERP platforms, including demonstrated experience translating AI capabilities into an executable roadmap across Finance, HR, data, workflows, controls, and employee experiences.
Proven leadership of large, multidisciplinary teams responsible for ERP, AI, data, architecture, integration, security, and program delivery, with the executive presence to align senior business and technology stakeholders.
Financial Services industry (in a highly regulated environment) and finance/accounting experience is strongly preferred.

Company Description
Healmenow Inc. is a health-tech startup focused on creating a more continuous mental health support experience, especially in the moments between traditional appointments. The company is rethinking mental health care through a human-centered approach that emphasizes adherence, continuity of care, and everyday support. Heal leverages technology to help individuals access timely, supportive interventions and tools beyond the therapy session. The team is driven by a mission to improve real-world mental health outcomes through thoughtful product design and responsible innovation.
Role Description
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will lead the overall technology vision and execution for Healmenow Inc., ensuring alignment with the company’s mission and product roadmap. This full-time, on-site role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and will oversee software engineering, technical architecture, infrastructure, and security across all products and platforms. Day-to-day responsibilities include guiding the development of scalable and reliable software solutions, collaborating closely with product and design teams to translate user needs into technical requirements, and managing technical roadmaps and priorities. The CTO will build and mentor a high-performing engineering team, establish best practices for software delivery and quality, and evaluate new technologies that support continuous mental health care. The role also involves partnering with leadership on strategic planning, budgeting, risk management, and compliance, particularly in areas related to data privacy and healthcare regulations.
Qualifications

Strong experience in Software Development and Product Development, with a track record of delivering secure, scalable, user-centered digital products.
Expertise in Architecture and IT Strategy, including designing cloud-based systems, setting technical standards, and aligning technology decisions with business goals.
Proven Project Management skills, including leading cross-functional initiatives, managing timelines and resources, and implementing agile methodologies.
Experience building and leading engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative culture.
Deep understanding of modern technology stacks (e.g., cloud platforms, APIs, mobile/web frameworks), DevOps practices, and security and data privacy best practices.
Prior experience in health-tech, digital health, or other regulated industries is highly beneficial; familiarity with HIPAA or similar standards is a plus.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business and product implications.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent practical experience in technology leadership is preferred.
A good attitude, curiosity and problem solver.

added.description:
About the Role

Job Type: 
Full-time  | Location: 
San Francisco  | Department: 
Procurement  | Reporting to:
VP, AI Infrastructure Supply Chain |

Work Location Type: 
#hybrid

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

The Senior Director, AI Infrastructure Integrated Planning leads end-to-end capacity and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) for IREN’s AI Cloud data centers, integrating demand forecasts, GPU/server and all rack-level hardware supply, into a single, coordinated plan. Reporting to the VP, AI Infrastructure Supply Chain, this leader partners closely with Operations, Technical Sourcing, Engineering, Commercial, and Finance teams to translate customer demand and capital plans into region- and site-level capacity plans, hardware ramp schedules, and deployment timelines that scale AI Cloud and colocation infrastructure reliably and cost-effectively, with planning that extends from system-level capacity down through the full hardware bill of materials to critical components and their suppliers.

Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of progressive experience in data center capacity planning, supply chain planning, or infrastructure planning, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role, ideally at a hyperscaler, cloud provider, or AI infrastructure company.
Deep knowledge of GPU/compute/network/storage hardware lifecycles, lead times, and ramp planning and forecasting.
Experience planning and forecasting below the system/rack level to critical components (e.g., memory/HBM, GPU accelerators, networking silicon), including managing supplier-level demand forecasts, allocations, and commitments across multiple tiers of the supply base.
Proven track record building and running integrated capacity/S&OP processes that connect demand forecasting, region- and site-level capacity plans, and capital expenditure (capex) approval cycles in a fast-growing, capital-intensive environment.
Hands-on experience with capacity planning and DCIM tools/platforms (e.g., Kinaxis, o9, SAP IBP, DCIM systems) and strong SQL/analytics skills for scenario modeling and KPI reporting.
Strong executive presence and cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record presenting integrated capacity plans, risk, and trade-offs to senior leadership and the executive team.
Must be able to reliably commute to the assigned office location on scheduled in-office days under the hybrid work arrangement.
This role involves frequent travel to data center and supplier sites. IREN does not yet have an office in the Bay Area (a Santa Clara office is planned); until it opens, this role will work remotely, transitioning to hybrid on-site work once the office is established.

Job Responsibilities:

Drive Run-the-Business (RTB) centralized procurement operations across both direct and indirect spend, bridging operational execution with technical engineering, demand planning, and corporate finance. 
Streamline and govern the Purchase Requisition-to-Purchase Order (PR-to-PO) pipeline and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) to minimize cycle times, enforce buying policy, and ensure purchasing compliance. 
Execute Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) and vendor governance for extended workforce partners and indirect service providers, applying the risk framework and SLA standards set by Strategy and Transformation to ensure compliance and mitigate risk. 
Own supplier onboarding and enable Accounts Payable by ensuring complete, policy-aligned supplier and purchase records that support accurate invoice matching and payment. 
Operate and continuously improve the procurement systems and tooling (P2P, CLM, automated tracking) within the systems strategy set by Strategy and Transformation, ensuring accurate data flow and seamless user adoption while championing GenAI-enabled workflows and automation to eliminate manual overhead and accelerate operational throughput. 
Drive cost optimization and cost avoidance across business operations and indirect procurement spend. 
Oversee indirect procurement operations across critical non-BOM categories, including contingent workforce, engineering services, specialized construction tools, and software licensing. 
Operate reporting and dashboards against the KPI framework set by Strategy and Transformation and lead Monthly (MBR) and Quarterly (QBR/EBR) Business Reviews with senior leadership on spend compliance, operational health, SLA performance, and budget variances. 
Recruit, mentor, and scale a team of supply chain operations managers and program managers, cultivating an agile, data-driven culture of operational excellence and cross-functional partnership across global regions. 
Must be able to reliably commute to the assigned office location on scheduled in-office days under the hybrid work arrangement.
This role may involve periodic travel to supplier and vendor sites, data centers, and industry events. IREN does not yet have an office in the Bay Area but one is planned. Until it opens, this role will work remotely, transitioning to hybrid on-site work once the office is established.

Job Benefits:

Salary range (for San Francisco, California location) : USD  $300,000 - 375,000/annum, depending on experience
Short-term and Long-term Incentive Programs
Health Insurance, Disability Insurance, Life Insurance, Vision care & Dental care
401k Retirement Plan
